metrics.method: Full history from 2025-07-24 to 2026-10-08: 1,151 non-service messages (584 client, 567 ALTR plus vendors). The client is 'Eli' per config/clients.yaml, and every other sender counts as our side. Topic = forum topic, worked out by following reply chains back to the TopicCreate. Client messages were grouped into 271 bursts (same topic, gaps under 6h, broken by any of our messages in that topic), and 70 of those bursts contained a '?'. 'Unanswered >24h' = no message from our side in the same topic within 24h of the burst's last message: 22 bursts. Lag: median 3.2h, p75 48h, p90 258h. This lag method is a little tighter than the 09-25 run (13.2h median), so compare the counts, not the medians. Two 2026-09-24 bursts formally got a later in-topic message, but neither got a substantive answer: the reels/picks question is still open after 15 days, and the Dropbox delivery went 14 days without acknowledgement. Max team silence = longest gap between consecutive messages from our side: 27.0 days (2026-05-05 to 2026-06-01, unchanged). In this window the longest gap was 5.1 days (09-23 to 09-28), and it covered her 17-message return. Promises: 38 as of 09-25, plus 4 new (Stephski 'ill lyk' 10-01, kept 10-07; Stephski 'Let me check this morning' 10-03, answered 10-07; Melissa's dated 10-06 repost push, kept; Aroosha 'check in with the team' 10-08, still open). One earlier lapsed promise, Stephski's 'ill let you know when it clears' on the $10k wire, is now counted as kept late, because the 10-01 invoice rolled over the resulting overpayment. That gives 18 kept, 23 lapsed and 1 open.
